info.description: Backend API for tracking movies and TV shows.
info.title: Watchlist API

get.description: Handles the Discord redirect, issues a JWT, and redirects to the frontend
Redirects the user to Discord's OAuth2 login screen
Returns the user's upcoming releases (unreleased movies and not-yet-aired episodes of watchlisted shows), soonest first.

post.description: Re-syncs the user's calendar from their watchlist against the meta service, then returns the updated list. Useful right after adding an upcoming title.

get.description: Returns a single catalog of movies/shows. Use `sort` (with optional `genre`) for the popular/top-rated catalogs, `year` for one release year, or `provider` for a streaming service. `provider` takes precedence over `year`, which takes precedence over `sort`. Results are cached for 1 hour.

parameters.description: Genre filter, e.g. action, sci-fi (series also: reality-tv, talk-show, game-show)
parameters.name: genre

get.description: Returns all four catalogs (popular movies, popular shows, top-rated movies, top-rated shows) in a single request. All results are cached for 1 hour.
Returns the user's most recent tracked events, newest first. Useful for a transparency/activity feed.

post.description: Accepts a batch of client-reported events (play/pause, heartbeats, page views, etc.) and appends them to the user's activity log. Events with an empty or over-long type are skipped.

get.description: Returns full metadata for a movie by ID. Results are cached for 24 hours.
Returns full metadata for a series by ID, including all episodes in the videos array. Results are cached for 24 hours.
Returns the user's most recent notifications plus the unread count

patch.description: Marks every unread notification for the user as read
Marks a single notification as read

get.description: Searches for movies and/or shows by query string. With no type filter, returns mixed results weighted by recency.
Returns the authenticated user's all-time activity summary: totals, watch time, top genres and top titles.

Returns the authenticated user's "wrapped" stats for a year: watch time, counts, top genres/titles/decades, monthly/hourly/weekday histograms, streaks and night-owl flag. Defaults to the current year.
Returns a paginated, filterable list of watchlist items

delete.description: Deletes multiple watchlist items by ID in a single request

parameters.description: List of item IDs to delete
parameters.name: body

get.description: Returns a single watchlist item by ID

put.description: Creates or fully replaces a watchlist item

delete.description: Deletes a watchlist item by ID

patch.description: Lightweight progress-only update without replacing the full item
Sets the watch status of an item (watching, watched, plan_to_watch, paused, dropped)

released.description: Released is true once the release date has passed.

avatar.description: omitempty means if field is empty, it will be omitted from the JSON response.

BearerAuth.description: Enter your JWT token as: Bearer {token}
BearerAuth.name: Authorization
